good:
The Software Developer opening on your platform team stood out because the work centres on exactly what I've spent the past two years building: web applications that turn messy real-world data into something people can act on. At Conestoga's Open Education department I supported over a thousand students across three programs, and that experience of shipping tools real people depend on is the value I'd bring to your team.

My capstone project is a good example of how I work. Entrepreneurs kept asking the same question, whether a business would survive in a given neighbourhood, and the answer was buried across census tables and map data nobody had joined together. I spent weeks structuring that data before writing any application code, because I'd learned that a clean data model makes every later decision easier. The finished platform lets someone compare locations across hundreds of municipalities and see the reasoning behind each score. What I took from it wasn't the tooling; it was the habit of starting from the user's actual decision and working backwards to the data.

Your team ships features end to end, and that's how I like to work: own the problem, keep the scope honest, and make sure what ships actually helps the person using it. I bring current, hands-on project experience, two co-op terms of professional practice, and the work habits of someone who finishes what they start. I can be reached at girishbhuteja07@gmail.com or (416) 473-8204.
